title: Zillow Properties - Rentals, New Listings & Price Changes
description: Minimal input: {"searchUrls": ["https://www.zillow.com/austin-tx/"], "maxResultsPerSource": 3}. Cost: $0.02 per parsed page + $0.002 per delivered property. Set maxTotalChargeUsd in Apify run options, not input. Unchanged or filtered pages are billed.

searchUrls.title: Search URLs
searchUrls.description: Zillow city sale or rental search URLs, for example ["https://www.zillow.com/austin-tx/"] or ["https://www.zillow.com/austin-tx/rentals/"]. Up to 20. HTTPS www.zillow.com only; property-detail and building-detail URLs are not accepted. Query parameters from pasted searches are preserved.

maxResultsPerSource.title: Maximum delivered rows per source
maxResultsPerSource.description: Maximum delivered property or rental-building rows per search URL, after filters, monitoring and cross-URL deduplication. Default 50; maximum 1000. Deduplication uses output id: zpid for a property, a building-* ID for a rental building. Different listings on zillow.com remain separate; the same listing across URLs is delivered once. Source availability and page caps can leave fewer rows.

minPrice.title: Minimum price
minPrice.description: Minimum price in source numeric fields, for example 400000. Zero disables the bound. Missing values do not pass active bounds; rental buildings usually have null scalar price/beds and are excluded when those bounds are active. Unit options are preserved separately.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price
maxPrice.description: Maximum price in source numeric fields, for example 400000. Zero disables the bound. Missing values do not pass active bounds; rental buildings usually have null scalar price/beds and are excluded when those bounds are active. Unit options are preserved separately.

minBeds.title: Minimum bedrooms
minBeds.description: Minimum bedrooms in source numeric fields, for example 3. Zero disables the bound. Missing values do not pass active bounds; rental buildings usually have null scalar price/beds and are excluded when those bounds are active. Unit options are preserved separately.

maxBeds.title: Maximum bedrooms
maxBeds.description: Maximum bedrooms in source numeric fields, for example 3. Zero disables the bound. Missing values do not pass active bounds; rental buildings usually have null scalar price/beds and are excluded when those bounds are active. Unit options are preserved separately.

onlyNewOrChanged.title: Only new or changed rows
onlyNewOrChanged.description: true emits new IDs or changes in price text, numeric price, currency, status or building unit options. First run delivers the baseline; use the same monitorKey later. Successful unchanged checks still pay page fees. Default false.

titleContains.title: Title includes any
titleContains.description: Keep titles containing any phrase, case-insensitive, for example ["engineer"]. For Zillow, title is building name or address. Empty disables it. Applied before row billing; parsed pages are still billed.

titleExcludes.title: Title excludes any
titleExcludes.description: Drop titles containing any phrase, case-insensitive, for example ["senior"]. Empty disables it. Filtered rows have no row fee; parsed pages still carry their fee.

monitorKey.title: Monitor name
monitorKey.description: Persistent history name, for example "daily-watch". Use 1–60 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Use the same targets, filters and name for repeat runs. Keeps the latest 50,000 delivered IDs. Do not overlap runs sharing this name.

excludeIds.title: Previously collected IDs
excludeIds.description: Skip exact output id values. Up to 10,000. Useful for external deduplication; excluded rows have no row fee, but parsed pages are billed.

maxPagesPerSource.title: Maximum pages per source
maxPagesPerSource.description: Safety cap on parsed pages per search, for example 5. Default 5, maximum 20. Each parsed page costs $0.02, including filtered or unchanged checks. Both this cap and maxResultsPerSource apply.
